_comment: Real output: the incidentInfo aspect DataHub stored after `modelguard scan`
raised a FRESHNESS incident on the stale source table. Read back from a
local OSS Quickstart with graph.get_aspect(urn, IncidentInfoClass).
An incident cannot attach to an mlModel: incidentInfo.entities accepts only
dataset, chart, dashboard, dataFlow, dataJob, schemaField. Model-level risk
is carried by the modelguard.* structured properties instead.

incidentInfo.title: Stale upstream data in ecommerce.public.loans_raw
incidentInfo.description:
ecommerce.public.loans_raw last changed 30.0 hours ago, against a freshness SLA of 6.0 hours.

Models at risk: 1 (1 currently serving).
  - Credit Risk v3 [critical] live, 3 hops downstream

Downstream datasets: 1. Downstream features: 2.

Freshness was measured from the dataset's operation aspect, DataHub's record of when the table last changed. ModelGuard did not query the warehouse.

Assessment:
ecommerce.public.loans_raw has been stale for 30.0 hours, and 1 model(s) behind a live endpoint (Credit Risk v3) are scoring production traffic on features derived from it. Predictions are being served against inputs that no longer reflect the source system, and nothing in the serving path would surface that. Refresh the upstream table, then confirm the affected endpoints recover before trusting their output.

Raised by ModelGuard run gate1-6c2236de.
